name: Troll Charm
summary: In Ashenvale, Troll Charms have been taken from fallen Darkspear travelers. The Thistlefur furbolgs seized the sacred amulets after ambushing the party on its way to Zoram'gar Outpost.

sections.title: Sacred Trinkets of the Darkspear
sections.body: Darkspear trolls carry spiritual charms as marks of dignity. Scout Mitsuwa says a troll without one is as diminished as an orc without battle scars. A party of Darkspear kin traveled through Ashenvale's canopy toward Zoram'gar Outpost when corrupted Thistlefur furbolgs ambushed and slaughtered them. Their spirits were commended to the afterlife, while the furbolgs took the charms as trophies and stashed them in chests deep within Thistlefur Hold.

faq.q: What are Troll Charms used for?
faq.answer: Darkspear trolls carry Troll Charms as sacred spiritual wards and marks of personal dignity.
The charms are locked in chests within Thistlefur Hold, a cavern system behind Thistlefur Village in northern Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why do the furbolgs have these charms?
faq.answer: Thistlefur furbolgs ambushed and killed Darkspear travelers bound for Zoram'gar Outpost, then ransacked their belongings and kept the charms.
Mitsuwa, a Darkspear troll stationed at Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand, seeks the charms to restore honor to his slain kin.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, leaving sacred charms with savage furbolgs is an intolerable insult to your fallen kin.
As a member of the Horde, recovering the stolen charms weakens the aggressive Thistlefur tribe and avenges Horde travelers slain on Ashenvale's treacherous paths.
